profile.name: Vaishnav P M
profile.tagline: I build production web and mobile applications with React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.
profile.bio: Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience developing and maintaining production web and mobile applications. I build responsive interfaces, reusable components, server-side applications, and database-backed workflows using React.js, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. My work spans authentication, third-party integrations, asynchronous processing, performance optimization, and production support, from business requirements through release.

experience.summary: Developed and maintained 30+ production modules across 12 release cycles for a multi-tenant marketing research SaaS platform.
highlights: Built responsive, reusable React.js and Next.js interfaces for meetings, calendars, discussion guides, polls, takeaways, reporting, and AI-enabled research workflows.
Developed Node.js/NestJS applications and microservices, designed and documented 60+ REST API endpoints, and implemented PostgreSQL workflows, JWT, RBAC, input validation, and Redis-backed queues.
Improved application performance by approximately 25% / 200 ms through React Query caching and invalidation, fewer repeated API requests, and Vite bundle optimization.
Integrated video, streaming, third-party, and AI analysis services; resolved 20+ defects and collaborated on code reviews, testing, documentation, and CI/CD releases.

experience.summary: Built and shipped 4+ production web applications across event registration, ticketing, e-commerce, and CRM.
highlights: Developed responsive React.js interfaces and Node.js/Express.js services with PostgreSQL, REST APIs, authentication, and third-party integrations.
Reduced deployment time from 30 minutes to 10 minutes with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment.
Resolved 50+ production incidents through application debugging, API investigation, root-cause analysis, and infrastructure coordination.
Shipped 10+ iOS and Android releases using React Native and Firebase Authentication; reviewed code and mentored 3+ interns.

experience.summary: Provided L2 application, network, and server support for enterprise environments.
highlights: Maintained 95% incident closure within SLA through structured troubleshooting and coordination with infrastructure teams.
